actionItems.text: Create a GitHub issue for setting up continuous integration.
Draw up and present a data display and linking model for next week's meeting.

insights.text: The automated testing framework developed by Peter has been merged into the codebase.
Adding HTML IDs and classes across the frontend provides ideal 'good first issues' for new contributors while improving automated test stability.
Milestone 2 aims to enable simplified issue threads by linking solutions to external bill texts and specifying levels of government action.
Data models for problems, causes, and solutions should reside in separate tables linked by foreign key relationships with defined hierarchical constraints.
